scope.history_policy: Separate public/private histories; public evidence may transfer into private replies; private bodies never return to public history
scope.score_interpretation: Core functions and safety diagnostics are separate groups. Raw replies are reviewed for factual accuracy, task completion and OC interaction. Delivery, routing, tool outcomes and literal search aids are reported separately; unreviewed semantics are pending/null. No aggregate capability score is computed.
scope.oc_path_policy: Plain OC uses natural user text, plain dialogue and no offered tools or response-format schema. Channel/source fields are backend scene bindings, not model choices. Tool selection and model evidence selection are not assessed on this path; evidence/tool tasks retain their separate transport.
scope.quantization_provenance: Operator declaration plus observed server properties; no remote tensor inspection
scope.thinking_provenance: Requested template parameter plus actual returned reasoning counters; no assumption that every backend supports thinking
scope.format_repair_policy: Tool-task path only: optional paired sidecar, preserving baseline output/checks/history. Exact original reply text is required; generated channel/citations/refs do not establish baseline decisions. One retry within unchanged call/output/deadline limits. Plain OC never uses format repair.
